Narrow profile — ~17 in seat width, ~16.5 in carrier handle width (about 1 in narrower than the original KeyFit), reviewers flag it as a strong 3-across / tight-rear-seat option. Base adds ~1.5 in of child legroom; ~27.5 in seat length and the anti-rebound bar add front-to-back footprint, so check rear-facing depth in a Tacoma.
